name: siren-gmmq05
description: Reverts the encoder to the checkpoint used by the 2026-08-10 notebook run, which scored SR median 95.92 / SWD 0.1113 / JSD 0.0106 against the current baseline's 90.89 / 0.1927 / 0.0268 at identical mass IoU. Changes only the SIREN weights and the query fraction they were meta-trained with; every other field is inherited. Restore the checkpoint with: git cat-file -p 3007ed9:constrained_fm/functa_dataset/siren_best.pt > constrained_fm/functa_dataset/siren_gmmq05.pt   (sha256 8d02273354)
